description.en:
General map 1:4 500 000 by the National Land Survey is a general map dataset depicting the terrain of the whole of Finland. General map 1:4 500 000 has been produced by using data from General map 1:1 000 000, Map names of the product Geographic names and Municipal division 1:4 500 000. The key objects on General map 1: 4 500 are waterways, the traffic route network, geographic names and administrative borders. The municipal division, administrative names and the main roads and railways are updated yearly and the other elements every 5 years. General map 1:4 500 000 is available as a version that covers the whole country. General map 1:4 500 000 is delivered in the ETRS-TM35 coordinate system. The product is in vector format.

Coordinate Reference System: ETRS89 / ETRS-TM35FIN (EPSG:3067)

values: Regionförvaltningsverket i Västra och Inre Finland
